title: Staff Training Assistant
businessOutcomes: New staff get answers without interrupting the owner.
summary: Turn SOPs and handbooks into interactive training quizzes and Q&A assistants new hires can use on day one.
businessProblem: New hires shadow experienced staff for weeks because training materials are outdated PDFs nobody reads. The owner repeats the same explanations, and consistency across locations suffers.
outcome: New hires get an AI training assistant that answers questions from your actual SOPs, plus auto-generated quizzes to verify understanding before working independently.
expectedOutcomes: New hires get an AI training assistant that answers questions from your actual SOPs, plus auto-generated quizzes to verify understanding before working independently.
whoItsFor: Businesses hiring 2+ people per quarter who have SOPs or handbooks (even rough ones) and need consistent onboarding without the owner delivering every training session.
aiInputs: Common questions new hires ask in first 30 days
Safety and compliance requirements for the role
aiOutputs: Q&A assistant grounded in company documents (answers with source citations)
Role-specific quiz (10–15 questions) generated from SOPs
Gap report: topics in SOPs that lack clear documentation
noCodeTools: ChatGPT custom GPT uploaded with handbook/SOPs
Notion AI Q&A over training database
Trainual or Lessonly with AI content import
lowCodeTools: Custom GPT or Claude Project with document knowledge base
n8n: new hire added to sheet → training quiz generated → email sent
customBuildStack: OpenAI for quiz generation from SOP content
Simple web UI or Slack bot for trainee access
implementationSteps: Gather all training materials: SOPs, handbook, safety docs
Upload to knowledge base (custom GPT, Notion, or vector store)
Define role-specific training paths and quiz requirements
Generate initial quizzes from SOPs and review with department lead
Deploy Q&A assistant for new hires with 'ask anything' access
Collect questions the AI couldn't answer → identify documentation gaps
systemBehavior: Available on-demand for trainee questions (not scheduled)
Answers only from uploaded documents — says 'I don't know' when unsure
Cites source document and section for every answer
Quizzes generated per role, not one-size-fits-all
Does not replace hands-on supervised practice for physical tasks
risks: AI may answer confidently from outdated SOPs without flagging age
Safety-critical procedures must have human verification, not AI-only training
Staff may use AI as shortcut instead of reading actual SOPs
Knowledge base must be updated when procedures change
